originalMetadata.title: Force Your Brain to Be So Disciplined It Feels Scary
originalMetadata.description:
Be So Disciplined It Scares People | Build a Mind So Strong It Scares People | How to Be So Disciplined It Feels ILLEGAL

Struggling with self-discipline? Your brain isn’t lazy, it’s wired to keep you safe and comfortable. 
That’s why it resists the very habits that could change your life. 
In this video, I’ll show you 4 powerful steps to take back control of your mind, master self-discipline, and finally stay consistent with your goals.

You’ll learn:

Why your brain fights against discipline and how to reprogram it.

The secret to building unstoppable consistency with just ONE difficult habit.

How to create a simple discipline plan that actually works.

A proven way to commit and stay disciplined, even when you fail.

How to stack habits and achieve long-term growth without burning out.

Whether you want to be more productive, build habits that stick, or develop mental toughness, this system will help you become disciplined in every area of life.

Stop waiting for motivation. Build discipline that lasts.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - Introduction
0:39 - Step 1
1:33 - Step 2
2:27 - Step 3
3:05 - Step 4
